customer_name: Great American Entertainment Co. L L C

citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:37 am on
September 2, 2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee via phone call. A facility representative answered the
phone call stating they were short on staff and no one was available for inspection. Failure to provide access to the
facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access
is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section
